name: cloudflare-fullstack-template
description: Production-ready fullstack template for Cloudflare Workers + Pages

scripts.build: bun run --filter shared build && bun run --filter backend build && bun run --filter frontend build
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:backend && bun run deploy:frontend
scripts.type-check: bun run --filter backend type-check && bun run --filter frontend type-check
scripts.test: bun run --filter backend test && bun run --filter frontend test
scripts.lint: bun run --filter backend lint && bun run --filter frontend lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run --filter backend lint:fix && bun run --filter frontend lint:fix
scripts.clean: bun run --filter backend clean && bun run --filter frontend clean
scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --filter backend && bun install --filter frontend && bun install --filter shared

author: Your Name
